_howto: Guided setup for Settings (Demo / Setup mode).
title: Set up Settings
intro: Work through these in order. You're in demo: emails only go to your test mailbox, nothing is sent to devices, and nothing affects live until you push it.

steps.title: Company profile
steps.why: Your company's name, logo and details. These are kept centrally, so change them in live; in demo they can't be saved.

steps.title: Email
steps.why: The mail server the system sends from: approvals, reminders, payslips and reports. In demo, emails only reach your test mailbox.

steps.title: Other connections
steps.why: Single sign-on, Sage, an external T&A system or a CVS database, if you use them.

steps.title: Sync Engine
steps.why: How the mobile app is organised and synced: top department, sync method, and hiding tiles people can't open.

steps.title: Roles and permissions
steps.why: What each kind of user may see and do. Set these before creating users.

steps.title: Users
steps.why: People who log in, with their role and which departments they see. Create real user accounts in live: passwords can't be copied from demo.

steps.title: Access zones and devices
steps.why: Zones group your clocking devices; departments are then sent to their zones. Devices themselves are registered in live.

steps.title: Notifications
steps.why: Reminders and alerts: clock-in reminders, violations and who gets them.

steps.title: Test run
steps.why: Send a test email from Connectivity. In demo it arrives in your test mailbox, marked [DEMO].
